cells.gaps: No source found says an Ethiopian institution is live on PAPSS or another regional system; the National Bank joined PAPSS on 15 October 2026 (ETH-010). No figure for cross-border digital payments has been found.
cells.note: M-Pesa Global's Kenya-Ethiopia transfers (October 2024) and telebirr Remit (August 2024) put corridors in service. The National Bank formally joined PAPSS on 15 October 2026 (ETH-010) with no institution yet shown live on it, so not 4.
